full_judgment:
ATM Afzal CJ: This appeal by the defendants, following leave, arises out of a suit for eviction, Small Causes Court Suit No. 59 of 1986 of the Small Cause Courts Judge (Subordinate Judge, First Court), Chittagong which has been decreed on 30-9-1989 and the decree has been affirmed in revision, Civil Revision No. 425 of 1990, by the impugned judgment and order dated 9 February, 1994 passed by a Single Judge of the High Court Division. The appeal which is not opposed shall succeed in any case as the impugned decision has been made in ignorance of the latest law declared by this Division as to heritability of a monthly tenancy vide Pradip Das vs. Kazal Das 44 DLR (AD) 1. This is the only ground upon which leave to appeal was granted. 

 5. The learned Judge found the notice to be valid and sufficient and further that there was no illegality or irregularity in the judgment and decree of the SC Court and accordingly, discharged the Rule.
